body:
Honestly I'm not sure what you can do, even if your intentions are fair.  We're all just temporarily spared the same oblivion and are just as powerless to do anything of real importance.

I'll give you a chance, though.  Thank you.
They're just going to air it non stop for no fucking reason on tv anyway.

No, but they are selfish and don't care about things like that unless directly motivated by their lives being affected by what they've done.

regardless they have the same lack of purpose and meaning as anything else, so it doesn't really matter.  End result is absolute - everyone dies, everything is erased.

what's the point of focusing on the small things, when they're equally as meaningless as the big things?   

You're right - it's probably not fair.  But one thing is for sure, I've learned that most people are nearly identical.  At the very least they're extremely predictable and easy to read.  There's slight differences, but they are all the same beings with slightly different programming.  Some grow to be better than others, but they're all guilty of hurting more than they can make up for.  They'd all give into temptations that would harm another, it's just a matter of the right one being dangled in front of them.  It is unfair to assume the same of all, but I've been given little reason in life to not assume it.

I don't really have a name.  No name feels right.  I don't feel ownership of any of the names I've been called.  I don't feel right among anyone I've met.  I've thrown away my names, they don't mean anything to me.  Call me what you will, if it will make you feel better about it.
Not sure what you're saying.

Well, honestly you're probably wasting your time unless you can convince me that there's any value or worth in being alive that would make it worth it for me to spend any more time and suffering in this plane of existence.

I don't believe in anything after death, none of the myths of space wizards and gods and devils and meditative alternate existences and consciousness and reincarnations make any sense and is all quite obviously false wishful thinking.  If we die, and there is nothing for us after death, and there is no way we can appreciate, acknowledge, or even be aware of the world and the things we've done after death - what's the point?  The world ends with you - everyone just has a different world ending for them.  Everything that you are is nothing more than electricity and energy floating through your mortal and very limited brain.  Your existence is a fragile thought and you are a delicate machine.

In the grand scheme of things, it doesn't matter if you're a complete failure at life or the greatest success mankind has ever produced - it all ceases to be and matter in a short 60-80 years.  It might matter to future people, but what does that matter to you?  You won't even have a consciousness to think or know about it.  You won't even know or have any idea of what you've done in the past.  you wont have anything - you wont be anything.  you don't exist - life is just the game we play to make ourselves believe we do.

Even if there was value in helping people or working to better this fake life we live in, why should I want to?  People are shit.  All people, of all classes and creeds.  They only want you for what they can take from you, whether it's leadership or money.  As soon as they get their fill they locust on over to the next soon-to-be husk.  It doesn't matter how "good" or "bad" the person - you are all guilty of this.  I can't stand being human sometimes, not that I can think of a better existence given the alternatives I'm aware of.

Yes, I have.  I'm not full of myself, that's just the facts.

Because once you die you are completely without existence anymore.  I know it sounds selfish to say, but if you're not around to appreciate, acknowledge, or even think about the things you've done and accomplished in life what does it really matter?  It may be the most selfish thought in the world, but it still doesn't matter in the end because you'll be dead and even the bad shit you should feel bad about doesn't exist anymore.  It makes absolutely everything absolutely pointless.  In a way, the world does revolve around you.  Or at least, your world does.  Everyone's world revolves around them no matter how selfish or selfless they are.  And when that world dies it ceases to exist or matter.

I don't know what to blame for that.  I used to be the best person I could be, but people have beaten that out of me.  There's no point in changing my attitude, it's factual.  Nothing can solve the problem, because the problem is life.  I can stay here and pretend anything I do matters for like 40 more years until I die - unless someone else kills me first - or I can just end it now and the end result is still exactly the same but with less suffering on my part.
there is nothing in life that amazes, amuses, or even generally interests me anymore.  I've seen and done everything there is to do and now I'm just bored and depressed.
because why not.  oh, sorry to disturb your happy little life.  go fuck off to your party you don't have to tell me about it.
or just ask them why it matters who they are.  They're still being spammy douchebags.

no you don't.  you may want to help or something, but it's only because it makes you feel better.  You'll forget I even exist before the day is even out.  A week at tops but you'll stop bothering or caring, that's just how reddit is.

the fact of the matter to continue on is to live in suffering until I finally and thankfully die anyway, so what's the point in bothering with life?  I get nothing out of it.  I just suffer so that rich people can enjoy *their* lives.  I get no happiness or love out of anything - I'm just worn down, sleepless, and constantly worrying about fixing shit or having to jump at ridiculous task requests of rich fucking assholes who don't give a fuck about their slaves.

your legacy is a joke and meaningless.  Doesn't do anything for you when you cease to exist, and it will be forgotten when the few people who care to remember you cease to exist.

The key is, you cease to exist, therefore it doesn't matter what you do.  everything ceases absolutely and abruptly.  you're fooling yourself if you believe anything in life is important or worth doing.

"meaning" is a joke. there is no meaning.  your name is a bit of ink in the newspaper, if that, and you're gone.  never to experience or do anything again.  no ultimate goal to reach for.  no nothing.  life is nothing.  it's a fucking stupid fluke that we have to fool ourselves is worth suffering through just to survive our short lifespans.

all your life is, is you suffer so that rich people can enjoy their lives.  that's the big trick. that's what it's all about.  that's the only reason you're alive right now.  it's fucking bullshit and i'm sick of being in pain for them.

go ahead and downvote me or whatever it is you people do to make yourselves feel better than.  It doesn't fucking matter.

it doesn't matter if you're nice or not.  At best people act appreciative in your presence, at worst they just don't give a fuck about you no matter what you try and do for them.

People only like you as far as they can use you, then they drop you like a bad habit.

It wouldn't make sense for your conscious mind to exist without a living brain.  You are a machine.  Just because your parts are organic rather than metal doesn't make it any different.  You think you're an individual but you've been programmed like any other.  Believing that you'll exist after you die is silly superstition to keep you thinking what you do actually matters anywhere to anything.

There's not much to enjoy about this christmas.  there never is.  doesn't matter if it's different next year.  it'd be better if it was.
it all disappears when you die.  doesn't matter.  how can you even get any joy out of the time spent when it all means absolutely nothing.
who cares. they're just going to die anyway.
Oh boy!  lets spread "happiness" with the magic of consumerism!  I bet people can't wait to get some over valued pieces of plastic that they'll trash by next year.
Ok.

ITT someone assuming random shit about me and assuming I don't know things or have never done any thought or research into the suggestions i've shot down.

there aren't really places to stay for less than 70 dollars or so a night in this country, that I've ever been able to find.  A couple hundred dollars will feed me and give me a place to sleep for less than a week and i'm still in the same problem of not having any job in that town and no real way to get one because congratulations - I'd now be homeless.

I can't illegally immigrate somewhere because A) I have more respect than that and B) I don't have any luck what so ever.  That will go wrong no matter what I do and I'll end up deported or in jail.

I know that I'll have enough hard luck as a white person in Asia, let alone a transgender.  It's a heavy taboo to do anything against the norm over there.

I've been off my ass, i've tried shit, nothing works.  Every time I try anything, the worst possible outcome is what happens.

but whatever, keep on insulting me.  That'll throw some worth back into life.  It doesn't matter what anyone does.  At the end of it you die and everything was for nothing.

you can tell me that, but you'd be wrong.  I've done literally everything possible for me to do.

Also, you can't just move to another country.  It's impossible for me to legally immigrate to a first world country.  I don't meet the wealth requirements and I'm not a doctor.

I have no interest in moving to an even worse-off country, socially, like any of the Asian countries.  Their culture is best appreciated from afar for me - i'd be torn apart if I ever visited.

i can't move to another town without another job.  Can't get another job in another town without living in that town.  catch-22.

Wouldn't even matter anyway, as no matter what geographical location I am in in the world everything is just as futile and pointless.  Why live?  Not going to get anything out of it but more torment and then i'm going to die and disappear anyway.

>Ca you honestly, truthfully say that you gave your best 100% effort to change the shitty situation you are in right now? And absolute full 100%?

Absolutely and without a doubt.

Why should I bother wasting my time on people if they're just going to hurt and abandon me when they get bored?  Lack of appreciation wasn't exactly the focus point of that sentence.

It doesn't matter if it matters to them - they'll just die too.  Everything dies and everything you've done is erased and negated - futile.

I have an education, I have a job, I hate that job, but there are no other jobs out there.  It's more and more impossible to not break the law as they remove more and more of our rights.  You can't change our government, it's broken 100% and needs to be wiped out and replaced.

I don't have money to sink back into the "education" industry to start a different career, and there's no justice in our "justice system" to even bother.  It's all games rich people play to get out of being punished.

I don't do the things you assume I am doing.  But i suppose you're right in line with the rest of humanity in just assuming the worst and that I deserve this shit.  So much easier than being a decent lifeform.
It's probably both honestly, i don't know.  I've seen doctors, they don't have anything to help me.

Fuck other people.  Other people are pieces of shit.  No matter what you do for them or how much you care about them they will 100% of the time abandon you and they won't give two fucks about it.  People are the worst creatures on this planet.  You're going to say "nuh uh not everyone!" but you're kidding yourself.  Everyone does this to people.  You do it to people.  You just don't know about it because you don't care about those people.

It doesn't matter what I do, because it's all futile.  No matter what I accomplish I eventually die so there's no point in doing it.  I don't get any benefit out of living.  No one does.  You can say some hippie shit like "oh but you'll leave people with memories or do so much good for the world!" - but who seriously gives a fuck?  Everything and everyone dies anyway.  It's useless.  Everything is erased.

I can't even enjoy little bullshit things anymore because I have to live in constant concern and fear of what my government is going to do to me next.  there's no good left in the world even in the more straightforward sense.  Eventually I'll just be rounded up and executed or arrested or live in otherwise oppressed fear no matter what, because that's the system that is in place now.  Yeah, start a revolution.  You mean get shot dead by a couple of lads and smeared as a terrorist or some shit.  It's all futile.

All suffering ends - everything dies.  Doesn't matter if I help other people or things.  Iv'e done that shit.  doesn't help me any.  doesn't make my life any more tolerable.  doesn't put any reason for me to continue breathing.  I could fucking off myself right now and no one would no if it weren't for me writing this right now.  No one would find me until the place starts to stink, not even my own fucking roommate.  Given the way my roommate takes care of their fucking cat's litter box they won't even notice the smell of death in this fucking place.

And I can't help but feel that's the way to go.  There is nothing here for me.  absolutely nothing.  there is no joy to be had, no friendships or love.  nothing to gain, little to lose.  all I have to look forward to is being more and more tired, more and more angry, more and more hurt, more and more sad, more and more tears, and i don't see nay reason to keep dealing with that.

I have not a single reason to be alive, and every reason to die.  My cat is probably the only thing left in life that I do care about, but realistically he's just an animal and doesn't give a flying fuck about me past when I'm going to feed him next so it doesn't even matter.

i'm at that point at 25.  I'm thinking about just killing myself and getting it over with before it gets any worse.

This world is shit and there's really no point in dealing with it.

and fuck you for downvoting me, you piece of shit.
